title: Oven-Roasted Chinese Orange Roast
description: A savory pork roast glazed with orange, hoisin, and five-spice for a melt-in-your-mouth char-siu style.

ingredients.name: orange
ingredients.notes: use fresh oranges; juice and zest

instructions: Whisk soy sauce, hoisin sauce, honey, orange zest, orange juice, five-spice powder, sea salt, black pepper, and vegetable oil to create a glaze.
Pat pork shoulder dry, season with sea salt and black pepper, and place in a shallow roasting pan.
Brush half of the glaze over the pork; reserve the rest for basting.
Roast pork for 20 minutes to develop a charred crust.
Reduce oven temperature to 160°C and continue roasting, basting with glaze every 15 minutes for a total of 60 minutes.
Check that the internal temperature reaches at least 65°C; if higher, roast until 70°C is reached.
Rest pork for 10 minutes, slice into portions, and serve drizzled with remaining glaze.
